cases.expected: The visible setup journey contains Brief, Materials, and Generate with no teacher-facing plan-review stage.
Generate package enters the workspace and begins building without presenting Review the course plan.
Scion creates, validates, and signs an exact Course Map-bound instructional plan before selected deliverable compilers run.
A plan that cannot earn internal authorization stops generation as a Scion quality failure instead of becoming a teacher confirmation task.
The setup journey and three-step help dialog remain contained at the supported 320 px viewport.
Projects saved at the retired v0.18.2 awaiting-approval state continue automatically under the internal authorization workflow.

boundary: The benchmark verifies setup truthfulness, generation handoff, internal authorization wiring, recovery behavior, and viewport geometry. It does not certify instructional correctness, factual accuracy, accessibility, instructor approval, or classroom outcomes.
